display.title: Episode 480: A Diamond from Heaven
display.summary_short: Right after Shavuos, Uncle Yossi tells how Rashi's father threw a priceless diamond into the sea rather than let it decorate an idol, and was blessed with a son who would light up the world.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week after Shavuos. Uncle Yossi opens by describing Tzivos Hashem, the worldwide Jewish children's club, and how easy it is to join, even for a newborn baby. After the Hakochainik march, three sisters visiting from Los Angeles say the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time is framed as a father telling his son, who has just started learning Chumash, about Rashi. Rashi's father, Rabbi Yitzchak of France, a tzaddik and diamond dealer, buys a magnificent diamond at a bargain, only to learn that the governor wants it for an idol. After pouring out his heart in Tehillim, he decides to give the stone 'back to Hashem': on the governor's seaside porch he lets it slip into the sea. The next day a heavenly voice tells him he will have a son whose Torah will light up the world. The show ends with a listener's letter about hearing the Aseres HaDibros on Shavuos and the Shabbos candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Honoring Hashem is worth more than any fortune; a sacrifice made for Kiddush Hashem brings a reward more precious than diamonds.
